cori: Uploaded safetensors + manifest for aeon-13b v1 to s3://redwood-models/onboard/aeon-13b/v1/ — files: weights-00000.safetensors ... weights-00007.safetensors and manifest.json :rocket:

jaya: Nice. Quick question — is the shard ordering contiguous by TP rank or some alternate interleave? our loader assumes contiguous (rank-major).

samir: It's contiguous. I generated them with tp_rank as the fastest-moving index. manifest.json has a tp: 8 entry and shard_order: "rank_major". small snippet: ```{
  "tp": 8,
  "dtype": "fp16",
  "shard_order": "rank_major"
}```

eli: Heads up — tokenizer QC showed BOS token index is 1 in the uploaded vocab. That causes a stray "Ġ"-like token prefix when prompts start with BOS. We usually expect BOS=0.

cori: Ah that explains some weird decode samples I saw. I'll add a tokenizer_patch entry in manifest (bos_map: 1->0) and push a small vocab alias so runtime can apply it on load. Also note: safetensors created after fp16 conversion via safetensors-cli v0.2.3.

infra-bot: CI artifact: onboard/aeon-13b/v1 build #4532 uploaded, checksum sha256:abcd1234ef... :white_check_mark:

jaya: Can you also include the original pytorch checkpoint tarball? Need to verify any bias folding during quantize step.

cori: Uploaded original dump to gs://redwood-raw/onboard/aeon-13b/v1/orig_ckpt.tar.gz and added conversion log at s3://redwood-models/onboard/aeon-13b/v1/convert.log — notes about layernorm fused/no-fuse.

samir: One more gotcha: runtime expects tp_interleave=false by default. If someone saved the model with tensor_parallel interleave (we saw that from older TP code), loader needs a fallback reorder. I'll add a tiny reorder_convert.py and wire it into the onboarding scripts.

eli: For serving config I recommend the following keys in serving.json: 
- dtype: "fp16"
- tp_shards: "8"
- shard_strategy: "round_robin"  # runtime supports a fallback mapping
- tokenizer_patch: "bos_to_0"
- kv_cache_shard_align: "auto"

cori: I'll open a PR that adds reorder_convert.py, tokenizer alias, and a unit test that runs a 10-token forward on a 4-token prompt. @samir please review the TP layout fallback part.

jaya: tiny README request: add a short section in the S3 folder that lists tokenizer quirks (BOS=1), conversion tool versions, and manifest schema version so engs don't have to open PRs to find this.

samir: Sounds good. I'll review the PR tomorrow morning and focus on the reorder correctness and tensor strides. :thumbsup:

cori: local sanity check command I'm using: ```bash
python tools/validate_checkpoint.py \  --manifest s3://redwood-models/onboard/aeon-13b/v1/manifest.json \  --sample-prompt "Hello world" \  --expect-dtype fp16
```

eli: Note: if the CI test times out, it usually means KV-cache shape mismatch across TP shards. Try setting MAX_SEQ=2048 in the test harness or reduce batch size.

infra-bot: Reminder: retention policy set to 90d for onboarding artifacts — move long-term backups to gs://redwood-archive if you need longer.

cori: Thanks all — PR incoming in ~30m, will ping here when green.

jaya: ACK, will check the README and manifest after PR.

samir: Thanks, closing loop for now.
